health_gates.reason: Blocking diversity gate. FCNet real-learning reproduction has unique_int8=127+; the worst observed non-collapse baseline had 15. Threshold of 25 gives 2.08× FCNet safety margin and 40% baseline rejection headroom. M9 peek: [3, 10, 17] + all_pass (C2 flip, 2026-08-26) — file 3 is the narrowest-margin FCNet band (52 uniq), file 10 first mid-band exemplar (127), file 17 high-band exemplar (143). All_pass means a real learning model must clear the bar on EVERY peeked file; diversity collapse on any single peeked file fails the gate.

Blocking std gate. Complements output_diversity — an output with many unique values but tight std (edge-case not observed but theoretically possible) would also fail here. 1.0 mV threshold gives ~5× margin above worst-observed collapse (0.19 mV). M9 peek matches output_diversity: [3, 10, 17] + all_pass (C2 flip, 2026-08-26).

Blocking amplitude gate. Catches single-value-dominance collapse even when unique_count is above threshold (e.g. output has 40 unique values but 96% are the same one). Threshold 0.95 unchanged from rev-6; extended to every round. M9 peek: [3, 10, 17] + all_pass (C2 flip, 2026-08-26): a partial-collapse case where ONE peeked file has 96% dominance now fails the gate even when the other two are healthy. The flip discharges the m9 execution plan §9 Q1 deferral of exactly this choice to post-V17 empirical validation.

Records the spread of per-file pearson(CH1_denoised, CH2_target) as a single scalar: pearson_dispersion = stdev(per_file_pearsons, ddof=1). Empirical 24× separation between real learning (FCNet ~0.048) and paper-spec collapse (~0.002). Per-file pearson values are computed internally but NOT exposed — they were shown to be uninformative per-file (noise-limited on files 0-9; can sign-invert on high-signal files). See docs/design/paper_and_collapse_reference_baselines.md §6.3.
Records PSD(f_inj) / median(PSD_around_f_inj) per file. Direct spectral analog of the scoring pipeline's SNR; useful for detecting the "phantom scored high" case without triggering it. Never blocks.
Records per-file output std distribution (mean, min, max, per-file list). Complements output_std_blocking (aggregate) with per-file granularity for diagnosis. Never blocks.
